image_title: Regional Quarterly Performance and YoY Growth
summary: The table presents the quarterly performance of different regions, including North America, Europe, Rest of the World, and India, for the quarters ending June 30, 2024, March 31, 2024, and June 30, 2023. It also includes year-over-year (YoY) growth figures in both reported and constant currency (CC) terms. North America shows a slight decline in YoY growth, while Europe exhibits significant growth. The total YoY growth is positive, indicating overall improvement across regions. The table highlights regional contributions to total performance and growth trends over the specified periods.
